content.title: Outcome-First Product Proof | Work Backward from Result to Evidence
content.summary: Open on a legible ideal outcome, isolate the product as its causal object, and connect product to use through compact identity and material evidence. Relax back into the lived result and hold there. This is an evidence variant of the existing product proof state machine.

quick_start.input_format: Result preview screen + Original product identity + Assembly/condition evidence + Wearing or usage certificate + Environmentalized result final state
quick_start.recommended_input: First demonstrates the clear channel results brought by the goggles, then works backwards on module assembly, wearing and anti-fog proof, and finally returns to the final stable product state where the wearer completes the task on the river bank.
required_anchors: Show one desired outcome before explaining product operation.
Isolate one product as the causal anchor for that outcome.
Widen from product-dominant proof into the lived context.
Hold the outcome long enough to read the relationship.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Open on a legible ideal outcome, isolate the product as its causal object, and connect product to use through compact identity and material evidence. Relax back into the lived result and hold there. This is an evidence variant of the existing product proof state machine.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Open on a legible desired outcome before any explanation, isolate the product as the causal object, use a compact assembly of material or identity evidence to bridge object and user state, then widen into a lived outcome and hold. This source is an evidence variant of the existing product proof-state machine and must not create another selector.

invariants.rule: Show one desired outcome before explaining product operation.
Isolate one product as the causal anchor for that outcome.
Bridge product and user state with a compact proof assembly.
invariants.purpose: Connects object identity to lived result.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated transition makes the outcome feel unearned.

invariants.rule: Widen from product-dominant proof into the lived context.
invariants.purpose: Shows the result surviving outside the close-up.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close-only ad never proves context.

invariants.rule: Hold the outcome long enough to read the relationship.
invariants.ablation_failure: A rapid logo cut spends the result too quickly.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: RESULT FIRST and See what's possible copy
source split-panel assembly and Image + Video Seedance 2.0 mark
